thread.title: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners
thread.title_full: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners

author: admtahoe .
text:
"we have more than enough people that have been issued licenses for the three and a half million jobs that exist"
How is that different than most jobs? We generally have 3-4 million kids graduate college every year....There aren't that many jobs in the academic area they are getting a degree in. Art and English Majors, even in Finance, I'm pretty sure there aren't thousands of openings every year.
So most jobs have an abundance of workers which means as an employer you can set the wages....If Truckers don't like the "Third World Living Wages" then don't be a truck driver. No one is forced to do it.
I do know this, lower wages keep the cost of goods down for EVERYONE in this country. And shipping charges crush companies so yeah, companies will be looking to pay the least amount of money they can to move their goods.
It doesn't make it right or wrong, it's just the nature of the beast, but trucking damn sure isn't the only industry with more workers than there are jobs.
